_comment: Character Farm templates. Each bundles the reference style/pose + texture + rig target so one '--template' produces a game-ready (or engine-ready) character. 'synty_humanoid' is the default and the drop-in for THIS game (canonical Synty skeleton + 9 clips via fit_synty_rig.py). Add a template for other looks/skeletons. ref_kind selects the SDXL style/framing in gen_prop_ref_comfy.py (prop|character|creature).

synty_humanoid.description: Low-poly Synty humanoid for Hunkle Bunkle — drop-in (Synty skeleton + 9 game clips).

realistic_humanoid.description: More realistic humanoid proportions; still rigged to the Synty skeleton (drop-in) but PBR-textured.

quadruped.description: Four-legged pet on the project's quadruped rig profile (the committed fox-reference skeleton) — for AnimalCompanion3D pets (Frosty, Calvin & Coolidge). Drop-in quadruped rigging of a GENERATED body needs skeleton-fit R&D (same as the humanoid case), so today this falls back to a UniRig auto-rig unless the fit binds; /retarget conforms an already-quadruped-rigged mesh to it cleanly.

creature.description: Arbitrary creature/biped-ish — UniRig auto-rig, raw (retarget to an engine profile later if needed).
